segments.t: Giù all'ingresso, Hannah e Arthur aspettano con il fiato sospeso davanti alla porta della cantina finché Graham non risale pulendosi le mani con uno straccio e scuotendo la testa. Ascolta prima tutta la scena.
Tell me it was just a tiny air bubble, Graham! Please!
Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old boiler just gave up.
Does that mean no radiators tonight, or no hot water too?
The rooms will stay warm until morning, Hannah, because the brick walls hold heat.
Thank heavens! And the morning showers?
By tomorrow morning, the shower water will be ice cold.
Ice cold showers?! With the Portland Travel Guide inspector on the third floor?!
Do you have a spare brass valve in your toolbox?
Used my last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge sells this size.
What time does that hardware shop open?
Seven sharp, half an hour before breakfast.
Set your alarm, Graham. Tomorrow morning we beat the cold showers!
Ripercorriamo riga per riga questo verdetto dalla cantina.
Tell me it was just a tiny air bubble, Graham! Please!
'Dimmi che era solo una minuscola bolla d'aria, Graham! Ti prego!'
Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old boiler just gave up.
'Brutte notizie. La valvola a pressione d'ottone sulla vecchia caldaia ha appena ceduto.'
Does that mean no radiators tonight, or no hot water too?
'Questo significa niente termosifoni stanotte, o anche niente acqua calda?'
The rooms will stay warm until morning, Hannah, because the brick walls hold heat.
'Le camere resteranno calde fino al mattino, Hannah, perché i muri di mattoni trattengono il calore.'
Thank heavens! And the morning showers?
'Sia lodato il cielo! E le docce del mattino?'
By tomorrow morning, the shower water will be ice cold.
'Entro domani mattina, l'acqua della doccia sarà gelata.'
Ice cold showers?! With the Portland Travel Guide inspector on the third floor?!
'Docce gelate?! Con l'ispettore della Guida Turistica di Portland al terzo piano?!'
Do you have a spare brass valve in your toolbox?
'Hai una valvola d'ottone di ricambio nella cassetta degli attrezzi?'
Used my last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge sells this size.
'Ho usato l'ultima quest'inverno. Solo la vecchia ferramenta oltre il ponte vende questa misura.'
What time does that hardware shop open?
'A che ora apre quella ferramenta?'
Seven sharp, half an hour before breakfast.
'Alle sette in punto, mezz'ora prima della colazione.'
Set your alarm, Graham. Tomorrow morning we beat the cold showers!
'Punta la sveglia, Graham. Domani mattina battiamo sul tempo le docce fredde!'
Ascoltiamo un'altra volta tutta la scena a ritmo naturale.
Tell me it was just a tiny air bubble, Graham! Please!
Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old boiler just gave up.
Does that mean no radiators tonight, or no hot water too?
The rooms will stay warm until morning, Hannah, because the brick walls hold heat.
Thank heavens! And the morning showers?
By tomorrow morning, the shower water will be ice cold.
Ice cold showers?! With the Portland Travel Guide inspector on the third floor?!
Do you have a spare brass valve in your toolbox?
Used my last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge sells this size.
What time does that hardware shop open?
Seven sharp, half an hour before breakfast.
Set your alarm, Graham. Tomorrow morning we beat the cold showers!
Un presunto ispettore turistico al terzo piano, una valvola ceduta in cantina e una corsa alle sette del mattino oltre il ponte. Si chiude così il terzo episodio; ci ritroviamo nel quarto!
See you tomorrow!
